title: The Five Solas
lyrics_original: By grace alone I'm saved from my sin.
To God alone be glory! Amen.
The Word of God is truth revealed for man to know God's law;
The standard of reality, the Bible guides in all.
There is no other book divine, no other sacred tome,
The truth of God lies nowhere else but in His Word alone.
Salvation is a gift of God, so may no human boast:
By grace alone have saints been saved and blessed to uttermost!
No, nothing else can save my soul, my sin that can atone,
The sinner, now redeemed by God, is saved by grace alone.
By grace alone I'm saved from my sin.
To God alone be glory! Amen.
By grace alone I'm saved from my sin.
To God alone be glory! Amen.
The works of nat'ral man cannot appease the wrath of God,
Through Christian faith the Savior saves and stays the Father's rod.
For God could not my sin forgive through merits of my own,
The guilty wretch is justified by God through faith alone.
When first the sin of man appeared, the Lord withdrew His hand;
Thus Christ became a man and died to bridge the awful span;
No other One could mediate between me and God's throne,
The wayward son, restored to God, finds hope in Christ alone.
By grace alone I'm saved from my sin.
To God alone be glory! Amen.
By grace alone I'm saved from my sin.
To God alone be glory! Amen.
O praise the God who saves the weak, O glorify His name,
Let all creation with one voice His wondrous deeds proclaim!
Who else deserves the laud, the praise? It is not flesh and bone.
May all of life e'er glorify our King, our God, alone!
By grace alone I'm saved from my sin.
To God alone be glory! Amen.
By grace alone I'm saved from my sin.
To God alone be glory! Amen.

bible_verses.english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, that no one would boast.
Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness, that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for the incredible gift of Your Word, which lights my path and reveals Your true character. I am humbled that my salvation comes purely by Your grace and not by anything I have done. Forgive me for the times I rely on my own strength instead of resting in Your finished work. Teach me to treasure Your Scripture daily and live every moment for Your glory alone. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: The bedrock of our faith rests entirely on what God has given us, not what we could ever earn. Through His holy Word, He reveals His perfect truth to guide our steps, and by His unmerited grace, He rescues us from our sin. When we sing these profound truths, we are invited to lay down our self-reliance and boast only in the mercy of Christ. May our hearts find deep peace today, knowing that our salvation is secure in Him alone.
